recognize_zh: 手背與手指這些日曬部位散布糜爛、結痂、暗色痂皮與白色小丘疹（milia）及萎縮性疤痕，是遲發性皮膚紫質症（PCT）皮膚脆弱、起水泡後留疤的典型分布。
features: Multiple small erosions and dark hemorrhagic crusts on the dorsal hand and fingers
Pale atrophic scars and small whitish papules consistent with milia
Ruptured bullae and a larger crusted erosion on a fingertip/knuckle
Diffuse erythematous to dusky, sun-damaged skin background
Distribution restricted to a sun-exposed, trauma-prone site
describe_en: Clinical photograph of the dorsal hand shows multiple erosions, hemorrhagic crusts and dark eschars, together with pale atrophic scars and small white milia over the dorsum and fingers. Intact tense bullae are not clearly seen, suggesting a later stage after blister rupture. The distribution on sun-exposed, mechanically fragile skin is characteristic of a photosensitive blistering porphyria. Findings are consistent with porphyria cutanea tarda, to be confirmed by elevated plasma/urine uroporphyrin and heptacarboxyl porphyrins with reduced hepatic uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase activity.

ddx.vs: Skin findings are identical, but plasma and urine porphyrin levels are normal.

These produce the same blistering skin lesions but may have acute neurovisceral attacks and show a distinctive plasma fluorescence peak (~626 nm in VP) and elevated fecal protoporphyrin/coproporphyrin.
It shows trauma-induced blisters with milia but normal porphyrins and linear IgG at the dermal-epidermal junction on direct immunofluorescence.
EPP causes painful non-blistering photosensitivity with minimal scarring and elevated erythrocyte protoporphyrin rather than uroporphyrin.
